study type: Experimental animal study (in vivo and in vitro)
outcome: Circulating inflammatory cytokines (IL-12, G-CSF, KC, RANTES)
cohort: The study's in vivo component included C57BL/6 male mice at 20 months of age, while in vitro experiments used human myoblast cells.
finding: Fetal Sheep Muscle Extract (FSME) significantly improved lean mass, grip strength, and fatigue resistance in aged mice, promoted human myoblast cell proliferation, and decreased circulating levels of certain inflammatory cytokines without increasing overall inflammatory markers.
